toegepas.rede_vinder: The Afrikaans idiom is 'jou keel trek toe'; 'voel toe' is unidiomatic.
toegepas.fout: 'Jou keel voel toe' is a loose rendering of the fixed expression 'jou keel trek toe'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The fixed Afrikaans expression for a tight throat replaces a loose one with the same meaning, and the following comma before 'en' stays correct.

toegepas.voor: swaar en moeg en wil jy
toegepas.na: swaar en moeg, en wil jy
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb (jou lyf voel / wil jy), as elsewhere in the lesson.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb (voel jou lyf / wil jy).
toegepas.rede_keurder: The AWS 2017 comma before a clause-joining 'en', which matches the rest of the lesson, and the inversion still carries 'Dikwels' into the second clause.

toegepas.blok: Voel vir hom en wil help
toegepas.na: Jy wys dit gewoonlik met wat jy doen
toegepas.rede_vinder: Sitting down next to someone is not done with the hands, so the image does not fit its own example; 'gewoonlik' is kept.
toegepas.fout: 'Jou hande wys dit' does not fit its own example: sitting down next to someone is not done with the hands.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal says the same thing (deernis shows in what you do), fits both examples, keeps the protected 'gewoonlik' and adds nothing.

laat_vaar.blok: Voel vir hom en wil help
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'nie noodwendig' is the natural Afrikaans for 'does not necessarily mean'; 'nie vanself' reads oddly here.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Nie vanself nie' (not automatically) is natural Afrikaans and plainer for Grade 5, so swapping in 'noodwendig' is a lateral move that shifts the nuance slightly.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'vra' has no object here, so it is unclear what is asked; 'gaan na die volgende een' keeps the meaning of turning to the next adult.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Gaan vra die volgende een' is natural, clear Afrikaans in context, and 'gaan na' changes a safety instruction from asking an adult to merely going to one.

na_skrywer.voor: Sê dit vir 'n grootmens wat jy vertrou as jou maat lank swaarkry of as hy in gevaar is.
na_skrywer.na: As jou maat lank swaarkry of as hy in gevaar is, sê dit vir 'n grootmens wat jy vertrou.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'vertrou as' can be misread as 'trust as'; putting the condition first reads clearly and lets the next sentence follow on 'grootmens'.
na_skrywer.fout: 'wat jy vertrou as jou maat...' can briefly be misread as attaching the condition to 'vertrou'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The ambiguity is real but small, and this sentence is a safety instruction (when to tell, whom to tell), so the writer owns its wording.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.na: Om te verstaan en saam te voel deur jou
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: A definition starting with bare verbs reads as a fragment; the 'Om te' form matches the deernis entry.
na_skrywer.fout: The empatie definition opens with bare verbs, unlike the parallel 'Om ... te' form of the deernis entry.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: A real inconsistency, but this rewords a shared glossary definition beyond a plain grammar error, so it must change through the writer for every lesson at once.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: A comma after the embedded relative clause keeps 'swaarkry te voel' from running together for a young reader.
na_skrywer.fout: No comma after the embedded relative clause 'wat swaarkry', unlike the lesson's own convention ('waarop jy gehoop het, nie gebeur nie').
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: A real punctuation fault, but the deernis definition is shared word for word across lessons, so the writer should make the change in every lesson at once.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: Hy dra dit ook nie alleen nie.
vlae.rede: 'dit' has no clear antecedent (the burden is never named), and as a plain statement it says the friend does not carry it alone rather than that he need not; 'Hy hoef dit ook nie alleen te dra nie' may be meant, but that shifts the meaning, so a writer should decide.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Hartseer wys nie by almal op dieselfde manier nie.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Hartseer lyk nie by almal dieselfde nie.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Intransitive 'wys' here follows English 'shows'; 'lyk nie by almal dieselfde nie' is more natural and shorter.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'lyk' narrows the sense to appearance, while the paragraph describes behaviour (crying, going quiet, getting angry), and the original reads naturally.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Wat jy met 'n groot gevoel kan doen
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The disappointment is their own; the possessive reads more naturally than the definite article.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Afrikaans naturally uses the definite article where English uses a possessive, so 'die teleurstelling' already reads well and the swap is lateral.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Hy kan wel bly waar sy maat is.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Hy kan wel by sy maat bly.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'bly waar sy maat is' is wooden; 'by sy maat bly' is the natural phrase, keeps the meaning and matches 'Bly by jou maat' later in the lesson.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'by sy maat bly' can also mean staying over at or living with the friend, while 'bly waar sy maat is' says only that he stays present, so the preposition change moves the meaning.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Dit kan die grootmens by die huis wees
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Dit kan 'n grootmens by die huis wees
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The three options are parallel ('n onderwyser, 'n verpleegster), so the indefinite article fits; 'die grootmens' suggests one specific person.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'die grootmens by die huis' naturally means the child's own caregiver and reads well; changing it alters who to tell in a safety instruction for the sake of parallelism only.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The intended meaning is that the feeling makes you want to push back ('laat wil'); 'wil laat' says the feeling wants to make you.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'dit wil jou laat terugstoot' is idiomatic Afrikaans ('wil' meaning 'tends to'), so this is no grammar error, and the definition is shared wording.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'seermaak' needs an object here, as in the study text ('wanneer iets jou seermaak').
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Intransitive 'iets maak seer' is standard Afrikaans, so this glossary definition has no grammar fault to fix.
